title: POST /v1/gateway-deployments/{id}/health-report request body (as-built)
description: Every field is optional; the report is stored verbatim (plus derived 'version' and 'checks') into last_health_status. Named checks may arrive either as top-level keys, as a 'checks' object keyed by name, or as a 'checks' array of {name,...} items. Recognized check names: api_health, media_health, voice_gateway_health, realtime_worker_health, storage.

checks.description: Object keyed by check name, or array of {name:..., ok:...} objects.

last_test_result.description: Alias: test_result. Non-object values are replaced with {ok: false, error: invalid_test_result}.

version.description: Falls back to gateway_version, then voice/media body version, then server __version__.

public_url.description: Persisted onto the deployment row when present.

reported_at.description: Stored as last_health_at; defaults to server time.

realtime_validation.description: realtime validation report; compacted into gateway_health.realtime.validation.
